news.title: More Republicans come out against Trump's diesel deal with Putin
news.description: Senators told Trump, the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin "will not achieve just ends, nor will it benefit Americans."

news.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
news.description: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.

news.title: Airport attacks put aviation in crosshairs of geopolitical conflicts
news.description: Deadly attacks at Riyadh’s main airport are disrupting airlines, closing airspace and raising new security questions for commercial aviation.
